notes: Places for game/tests/headless_vehicle_contract.gd in the generated world: a parked car by the ferry to get into, a run along Seven Seas Avenue, a lane from Avenue N's seaward lane 14 m square across the verge falling to the east shore's riprap (no props in it; driven, crept and R from 5 m off the edge), a clear lane on the flat west shore for a short drive before the car is dropped on open water 34 m past the edge, the open north corner of the 12th Street and Avenue D dirt lot for the roll, a run-up 30 m before its medium kicker, a clear run-up of run_up_m square onto a joint (post p0:9, between bays 0:8 and 0:9) of a Cityside Park construction-panel fence, then a clear run from a road into bay 0:8 of a plain chain-link fence (the same bay key on a second fence), an Avenue N seawall shrub and palm, two Avenue of the Palms parked cars (the row's lone first car crept up to from behind in its lane, one hit across the road) and an 8th Street K-rail; once frozen, each shove target is hit again from its start; again_moves says whether it must also move (the car hit across the road ends in the bed against a building's wall, so it need only wake; the wedge target must move, and the K-rail or the row units it lies among). The ball case drives along the full-size pitch's long axis from 15 m back into the ball on its centre spot. The on-foot case walks, runs, rises and drops from open street by the K-rail case's start, clear of the K-rails the shoves scattered. If the world moves one of them, re-aim it here.
